notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.2.0
notes.content: [h3][b]Hello Splatians[/b]. This is yet another [b]quality-of-life patch[/b].[/h3][p]Over a year later, we are finally wrapping up some unfinished work – [b]mainly the music[/b]. [/p][p]Several areas were still using [i]placeholder[/i] tracks, and I had planned to remix some of [b]DarksSilencer[/b]'s pieces. Key spots like the S.P.A.R.K environment, [i]quantum labs[/i], and even the common boss theme were left incomplete. I always wanted the common boss theme to echo Lord Ashen's motif, so we have revisited and updated them.[/p][p]By the way, [url="https://www.youtube.com/@DarksSilencer"]give @DarksSilencer a YT sub[/url] - such neat indie music artists deserve more especially now![/p][h3]And then Lord Ashen appeared again.[/h3][p]The event lined up with [b]chocolatecake5000[/b]'s run uncovering another [i]softlock[/i] – perfect excuse to bundle bug fixes and music updates together.[/p][h3]Here's what's changed[/h3][olist][*][p]Fixed Library Tunnel [b]softlock[/b] reported by [b]chocolatecake5000[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed potential [b]softlock[/b] in [b]Quantum Power Area[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Replaced S.P.A.R.K., Quantum, and Storage Area themes with original music tracks[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced common boss theme with a new track by [url="https://www.youtube.com/@DarksSilencer"]DarksSilencer[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Updated Tomb and Arcade Boss battle themes with new originals[/p][/*][/olist][h3]Call to Action[/h3][p]Our first year was rough. We need your help to bring Desaturation more visibility. Share it with streamers or creators you know – most players who tried it enjoyed it.[/p][p]Thanks for being part of Splatland and helping close the book on the Desaturation project.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.1.9
notes.content:
[b]Hello Splatians[/b]. Another quality of live patch.

Kudos to community member and small streamer [b]Wankicha[/b] for finding very rare glitch that causes a barrel in Viscosity And Splattering to disappear. Well, the barrel never disappeared, it just got flinged into the stratosphere, or into the core void - as you decide to name it.

The game got some optimizations and some small quality of life improvements, too.

[b]Here's what's new & changed:[/b]

[list]
[*] Viscosity & Splattering - barrel bug fixed.
[*] Lord Ashen will never remove colored strips from itself during a specific battle
[*] The Rainbow Crystal of Essence can now double-hit Lord Ashen.
[*] Removed some enemy souls in the second area of Soul Realm
[*] Fixed some bugs of the JRPG Battle System (again)
[*] Removed a slime with Black Crystal protection in the Soul realm.
[*] Changed how the paint looks at some surfaces.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38396570/55ec815fd36e5938fce39dffff86c049b155c10c.png[/img]

[b]For those who actually read patch notes:[/b]
We love you! If you love Desaturation, tell your friends about it!

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.1.8
notes.content:
This patch fixes multiple issues found by community members. Kudos to tajskiKoks for the most important fixes.

[list]
[*] In the [b]Abandoned Mineshaft[/b] a barrel can get saved right on the moment when it explodes, bypassing softlock detection mechanism for this specific barrel. Now, the game will ignore any explosions that happen during load, the barrel will still explode, but the Splatian won't be harmed.
[*] While wearing the [b]Atom Hat[/b], you can end up softlocked in the [b]Control Area[/b]. It's now possible to exit this area.
[/list]

Some small issues related to input handling was fixed and some performance optimizations done in various places.

notes.title: It's that time! Cold, but...
notes.content:
[h2]Yes. It's the time for nominations.[/h2]

Maybe you will never forget what [b]that one slime[/b] did to you?
Maybe you forgot to jump in [b]that one pool[/b] to realize you had to [b]change[/b] how you look?
Maybe you did, but the scanner activated a trap and [b]betrayed you[/b]?
Maybe you jumped on [b]that moving platform[/b], but its color was wrong, and you became pancake?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38396570/5070d853c2d147d537941505abbcbe468cc90879.png[/img]

Maybe you managed to defeat [b]that one boss[/b], and [b]wasted 20 minutes[/b] on thing that [b]was in front of you[/b] all this time? Maybe you discovered one or two secrets there?
Maybe you [b]seen a thing[/b] but couldn't figure the way to go and take it?
Maybe you discovered a [b]sequence break[/b] that [b]saved you a lot of time[/b]?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38396570/55ec815fd36e5938fce39dffff86c049b155c10c.png[/img]

Maybe [b]your resilience kicked[/b] in and you eventually [b]explored all of Splatland[/b]?
Then you entered [b]the final level[/b] and got puzzled out, or felt some [b]retro nostalgia[/b] in there?

If you loved this experience, [b]nominate our game[/b] for the [b]most innovative gameplay?[/b]
And if you didn't and are still reading this, maybe go [b]play a bit more[/b].

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.1.2
notes.content:
[b]Hello Splatians[/b]. This is yet another quality of live patch.

[b]Yes, we had a secret ending[/b] that we decided to cut before the release, because it wasn't fully polished. But it looks like there was at least one way to trigger this extra content and get some missing dialogue that stalled the entire True Ending sequence, and at least one of you discovered this bugged mess. 

it was a glitch related to the Atom Hat and the Golden Relics.

[b]We've decided to just add this ending back[/b] & make it much easier to trigger. And we also fixed everything related to your Splatian's legacy. For you, secret seekers & Atom Hat lovers, the Ceremony Hall is important thing, but the Modular Factory is also important!

[b]Here's what's new & changed:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]The Super Secret Ending is now easier to discover![/b]
[*] Getting any of the 3 endings will now return you to the Temple prior the Final Battle
[*] Carefully checked the [b]Alex Taylor Secret Quest[/b] (Library & quantum MFA)
[*] Made many fixes to "Amnesia" chain, especially in the Soul Realm
[*] Removed the first Red Soul in the Soul Realm Entrance
[*] Slightly nerfed the souls in Soul Realm Pool Table
[*] Removed some enemy souls in the Soul Realm Maze
[*] Fixed some bugs of the JRPG Battle System
[*] Added some strong hints during the Final Phase of the JRPG Final Battle
[*] Fixed many dialogue issues in the Chinese translation
[/list]

[b]For those who actually read patch notes:[/b]
Library - Atom Hat - Ceremony Hall - MFA Switch - Relics - SlimRemote

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.1.1
notes.content:
[b]Hello Splatians.[/b] This is another quality of live patch + a community Chinese localization for the game.

[h2]Here's what's new & changed:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed some glitches related to DemonWare behavior
[*] Made the SlimRemote Equip button in the briefcase screen actually work
[*] Fixed the display in [i]Current & Information[/i]
[*] Added a cable in [i]Current & Information[/i] to hint more about that puzzle

[*] [b]ADDED Simplified Chinese community localization to the game.[/b]
[/list]
Note for [b]AMD Radeon[/b] users. A MAJOR issue have been identified caused by [i]third party overlays[/i] and the [i]AMD Adrenaline overlay[/i] on some systems.

Try updating your drivers and closing software that may interfere with the game.

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.0.9
notes.content:
[b]Hello Splatians![/b] We're happy to announce that a big quality of live patch that [b]adds some neat things[/b] and [b]fixes some stupid[/b] bugs is now a thing. 

[b]Here's what's changed:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]New mechanic: [/b]S.L.I.M.E. will not kill you if some of your colors match theirs.

[*] [b]Added overlays to the map[/b] for the pipeline, crystals and relic quests when you unlock them.
[*] [b]Barrels [/b]now actually have [b]rolling sound[/b] and [b]collision sound[/b].
[*] [b]Moving platforms[/b] also have sound effects when they are moving.
[*] Fixed environmental sounds in most levels, especially underground.
[*] Fixed Eaden's Store Item Slots becoming non-interractable after being cancelled
[*] The Status screen unlocks earlier
[*] Added missing collision in [b]Modular Factory Area[/b]
[*] Added extra cables to [b]Copper Tunnel[/b] and [b]Dwellings[/b]

[b]Call To Action[/b]
Feel free to share the game with [i]streamers [/i]and [i]content creators[/i] you know! 
[u]We need your help to make Desaturation successful.[/u]

[b]Community Translation Initiative[/b]

That's it, thanks for being part of Splatland and helping shut-down the horrible Desaturation project.

notes.title: DESATURATION warps into the handheld realm! Deck Verified ✅
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Splatians![/h2]

[b]Lord Ashen[/b] broke his boundaries one more time.  While Peter was chilling and working, Lord Ashen channeled its soul into his [b]quantumGG Steam Deck Mental Health Management Device[/b] made by one of the best and most influential teams in [b]quantum labs[/b] at the time - the legendary VALVE team! 
Peter had to summon the Splatians there however, because Lord Ashen was threatening everyone with its annoying tricks! Ranina isn't happy, too, while Sparkle still researches the [i]Rainbow Powder[/i]...

[h3]Enough [b]quantum labs inc[/b] fiction! [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38396570/5fddfbcba64ffdff44f9a7a5746bcac78ec0ce72.png[/img]

[h2]Desaturation is now verified on Steam Deck![/h2]

[b]The default settings are optimized for balanced experience. [/b]
This is a 10+ hours game. 

If you want to trade [i]more framerate[/i] for [i]less time on battery[/i], you can manually clock your GPU to 1.4GHz and above. For even more framerate but less quality, set In-game resolution to 848×480, quality to Marketing Mode and use Steam Deck's FSR. We also recommend keeping Tessellation to OFF on Steam Deck - while it makes the bricks and stones really appealing, this thing needs desktop class Nvidia dedicated GPU. We are also aware that some maps may not perform well, but in the upcoming weeks these places will also be fixed. [i](Yes, [b]quantum station[/b]).[/i]

[h3]Patch 1.0.8 contains fixes mostly related to optimization.[/h3]
[list]
[*] Underground trains no more cast super precise shadows.
[*] Most underground stations and some lights in tunnels were unnecessarily high quality.
[*] Marketing Mode fully disables the FSP Shaders now, may run faster on some cards
[*] Terrain shaders were slightly touched to better work on modern AMD GPUs.
[*] Fixed a potential soft-lock in Power Management (Atom Hat related)
[*] [b]S.L.I.M.E. will no longer insta-kill you if you share color with them![/b]
[/list]
[h3]Are you ready to save your Steam Deck from Lord Ashen?[/h3]

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.0.4
notes.content:
[b]Hello Splatians![/b] Improving, improving, improving... This small update is here merely to fix newly discovered critical softlocks and do some small improvements

Here's what's changed:

1. If you get stubborn enough and move the crate in the Reception out of the yellow pool, it will reset. (Thanks Mr. Necrotic)
2. In the Forest Tunnel there were some places that you can go out of bounds. They were fixed (Thanks to AirKris and OneMore)
3. Fixed some typos in Bulgarian translation (Thanks myself and Pumzow)
4. Some minor fixes to Corrupted Castle
5. Small adjustments to Slime AI, in preparation for the upcoming Slime Update.

[b]Reminder, we heard your feedback about difficulty![/b]
We are working on providing a difficulty setting for easier slimes and less deaths due to this, but we will keep the original challenging slime mode for those of you who want some challenge and it will remain the default.

[b]Call To Action[/b]
Feel free to share the game with streamers and content creators you know! We need your help to make Desaturation successful.

[b]Community Translation Initiative[/b]
We will soon start an initiative for community translation. If you want the game translated to your language, feel free to tell us in our Discord.

That's it, thanks for being part of Splatland and helping shut-down the horrible [i]Desaturation[/i] project.

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.0.2
notes.content:
[b]Hello Splatians![/b] A community Member discovered an interesting but very serious progression bug that may end you permanently stuck in the Divine Station Area. 

And while as usual, we blame [i]Lord Ashen[/i] for these, it was very stupid oversight.

[b]Here's what's changed:[/b]

1. Fixed the Copper Mine Station's Left Blockade area not blocking access to Divine Station. It's no longer  possible to enter Divine Station before it's intended time in the story.
2. If you are already stuck in the Divine Station area, The tunnel is now unlocked for you to backtrack and continue your run.
3. Added some cables and minor hints to places to hint you what to do.
4. Fixed the music in the Battle Of Balance (in Ceremony Hall).

5. [b]Steam Deck:[/b] We removed the Share/Import buttons on Steam Deck - using these can crash your deck and/or get the game into weird corrupted state. 

We're very sorry if you entered Western Village Area and got stuck in there. 

[b]And we heard your feedback about difficulty![/b]
We are working on providing a difficulty setting for easier slimes and less deaths due to this, but we will keep the original challenging slime mode for those of you who  want some challenge and it will remain the default.

notes.title: Desaturation Patch Notes for 1.0.1
notes.content:
[b]Hello Splatians.[/b] We had quite interesting launch day.
Some of you discovered [b]some interesting things[/b], in the good sense, but some of you discovered bugs. Nothing serious, except some really annoying rocks and lava!

As usual, we [i]blame Lord Ashen for them[/i], and squish them the same way we do with Slimes.

[b]Here is what's changed:[/b]

1. While nothing critical, we [b]dug some hole[/b] in a certain level so you won't need to reload your save because of soft-lock. P.s. you can tap Delete to reset checkpoint if you are playing with keyboard.
2. [b]The Basement Boss room was fixed[/b].
3. Fixed some minor z-fighting graphical glitches - there are some remaining, too.
4. Fixed some [b]very annoying section[/b] in the Mines, about rocks.
5. Fixed [b]Discord's Rich presence[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38396570/8450c982f9426c30b257c42b86a6b96a91d2879e.jpg[/img]
It now shows proper map percentage, and we added your death counter.
6. Fixed the Map Percentage in the status screen, too.

Minor stuff, but as a very small indie I want to be a good example of how I'm going to maintain the game.

With this in mind, what's next on the roadmap... is doing further polish and considering a mod support + level editor. [b]And community localizations![/b]

notes.title: ColorBlend FX v. 0.1.5! Welcome to S.P.A.R.K.
notes.content:
There's new Demo Update! [b]Version 0.1.5[/b] welcomes you to S.P.A.R.K![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38396570/6b6aabe7b6a37d30c80fa5ac49696c480402fc9b.png[/img]

[b]Here are some of the patch notes! 
[/b][list]
[*] There is something new in the first pre-"colorpocalypse" level! Welcome Squishy!
[*] There is something more challenging in S.P.A.R.K. Forest now!
[*] And actally there are some rooms from S.P.A.R.K in the demo! 
[*] Added details in most levels. Fixed hard-lock in the Library (sorry guys!)
[*] The slimes are now a paint blobs, though the old transparent slimes still exist!
[*] The paint was rewritten, it's now simulated. Yes, he paint spreads more. And looks much better!
[*] Only death from fall damage will now break your bones. 
[*] Slimes are much more violent now. Especially when you get slimed!
[*] Finally made water wash out paint from the world! (The rain was moved)
[*] Also, finally replaced that placeholder skybox with something better in all levels!
[*] Updated character control physics again! Much easier to stop if not running now!
[*] Aded some happy tune. And a sad one. And a beaty one! Especially during that boss fight in Forest!
[*] There are other minor things too!
[*] Unfortunately, we had to delete your old save file due to all these changes. But don't get angry - if you already played the old demos, these new bits are treatment for you!
[/list]

[b]ALSO THE CLOSED BETA is now OPEN![/b]
Just [url=https://discord.com/invite/w5DvMee]join our Discord​[/url] to apply! Everyone who makes some nice coverage or review is entitled to enter the beta. 

[b]AND IF YOU LOVED THIS UPDATE, TELL YOUR FRIENDS[/b]
Spread the word! let us all join and cooperate to remove the grayness around us and make ColorBlend FX a reality!

[b]ENJOY THE NEW UPDATE[/b]

Also [url=https://discord.com/invite/w5DvMee]join our Discord​[/url].[/b]

notes.title: ColorBlend FX: Demo Speedrun Contest (with PRIZES!)
notes.content:
Hello Splatians, Slimes and Ashen Minions! 
[b]THE DEMO SPEEDRUN CONTEST CONTINUES![/b]

[b]HERE'S WHAT TO DO:[/b]
[olist]
[*]Download the [b]ColorBlend FX: Pathway To S.P.A.R.K[/b] Demo.
[*]Play it, get used to it, [b]learn [/b]and master it. The demo is like 40 minutes to 1hr long!
[*]Start [b]a new game[/b], name your character [i]speedrun[/i] or just [i]q[/i]. This will enable the timer!
[*]Record your full playthrough! In Speedrun mode, story events will be skpped or be short!
[*]Using glitches is allowed, this is true (demo any%), we may even include it as official category.
[*]Post your video to YouTube! (or any video sharing site, as long as video is permanent)
[*]Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/w5DvMee]official Discord Server[/url]
[*]Post your video in the Speedruns channel. Only this way we will consider you as participant for the prizes!
[/olist]

[b]PRIZES:[/b]
At the beginning of January, following prizes will be awarded:
[olist]
[*][b]The current Speedrun World Record holder[/b] will receive a game on Steam of his choice up to $20. 
[*][b]The YouTuber[/b] with biggest audience / view count will also receive a game on Steam of his choice up to $20.
[*]Other participants will receive free games from our Humble Bundle collections.
[*]Also, some of you will be enrolled in [b]ColorBlend FX Closed Beta[/b]! 
[/olist]

The [b]more entries[/b] we get, the [b]bigger the rewards[/b] will be, it only depends on you all, so get in and [b]invite your friends[/b] to try the demo!

[b]Follow us, and share us, on social media - [url=https://twitter.com/petersvp]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/petersvp/]Instagram[/url] - to keep track of the game development and help us grow! Also [url=https://discord.com/invite/w5DvMee]join our Discord​[/url].[/b]

notes.title: ColorBlend FX: Pathway To S.P.A.R.K. v. 0.1.3f is released
notes.content:
​Hello everyone, known and unknown! 

After a lot of work, big fixes, refinements and what not, we finally released [b]the last Demo Update. [/b]

We're proud to announce the final update to our demo [b]Pathway To S.P.A.R.K[/b]  - version [b]0.1.3f. [/b]

[list]
[*] Refined the [b]first level[/b] and [b]Ashen's Lair.[/b]
[*] Refined and added small Sprint-jump tutorial section in [b]Towards Library[/b]
[*] Added more [b]Easter Egg[/b] names. E.g. [b]Link, Megaman, Cheater.[/b]
[*] Name him [b]q[/b] or [b]Speedrun[/b] to play in [b]Speedrun mode![/b]
[*] Significantly improved Speed Run Mode. The Timer now stops when Credits start.
[*] Changed physics (again) - player should't stick on ledges that much anymore.
[*] Fixed minor spelling mistakes (Not Ashen! He talks like that!)
[/list]

Enjoy the new update and share the game with your friends.

The game will be released somewhere in 2022. There won't be any new updates to the demo, so stay tuned for the actual game.

[b]Follow us on social media - [url=https://twitter.com/petersvp]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/petersvp/]Instagram[/url] - to keep track of the game development. Also [url=https://discord.com/invite/w5DvMee]join our Discord​[/url].[/b]
